build_idefics3_vision_embeddings: build a PyTorch module to create variable-resolution SigLIP vision embeddings with patch and position embeddings
create_idefics3_vision_attention: create a tensor-parallel vision attention layer with QKV projections and softmax attention for the Idefics3 model
create_idefics3_vision_transformer: create a vision transformer with embeddings, encoder layers, and post-layernorm for processing pixel values in Idefics3
create_idefics3_connector: create a modality connector with pixel shuffle and MLP projection to map vision features to text model dimensions
create_idefics3_conditional_generation: create a conditional generation model that merges vision embeddings with text inputs and returns logits using a text model
